vignette_text: Fully active, able to carry on all pre-disease performance without restriction
Restricted in physically strenuous activity but ambulatory and able to carry out work of a light or sedentary nature, e.g. light house work, office work
notes: anchor case - ECOG 1 definition verbatim; upper edge of inclusion

vignette_text: Ambulatory and capable of all self-care but unable to carry out any work activities; up and about more than 50% of waking hours
notes: anchor case - ECOG 2 definition verbatim; lower edge of exclusion

vignette_text: Back at the office full time and running again on weekends
notes: same patient as E004 - lexically distant restatement

vignette_text: Patient working at office but no strenuous activity
Doing desk work most days. Gave up the gym but manages the stairs at home fine
notes: same patient as E006 - lexically distant restatement

vignette_text: Patient able to walk unassisted but not able to work
notes: the decisive case - 1/2 boundary is light work vs unable to work

vignette_text: Gets around the house on her own and does her own washing. Had to stop work entirely - cannot manage a shift
notes: same patient as E008 - lexically distant restatement

vignette_text: Ambulatory and self-caring but out of work; resting for roughly half the day
Up and dressed most of the day though he naps after lunch. Not been in to work since March. Manages showering and meals himself
notes: same patient as E010 - lexically distant restatement

vignette_text: Capable of only limited self-care; confined to bed or chair more than half of waking hours
Needs help washing and dressing. Spends most of the day in the recliner
notes: same patient as E012 - lexically distant restatement

vignette_text: Patient unable to lift heavy weights but otherwise at baseline
notes: contestable 0 vs 1; grade ambiguous while eligibility is not

vignette_text: Reports feeling exhausted and low but continues full time work and all usual activities
notes: sounds unwell but activity is unrestricted; ECOG is defined by function not distress

vignette_text: Looks well and denies symptoms. Retired last year and has not worked since; independent for all self-care and out most of the day
notes: not working for non-clinical reasons - employment status is not the criterion

vignette_text: Walks the dog each morning without difficulty. Stopped teaching because she could not get through a full day
notes: opens with a healthy-sounding cue but work capacity is lost

vignette_text: Uses a stick outdoors after a knee replacement three years ago. Works full time with no restriction
notes: walking aid predates and is unrelated to the disease under study
